description: Cold email tools for HubSpot: what lemlist, Instantly, Apollo, and Seamless.AI sync to your CRM, plan notes, and when HubSpot sequences are enough. Checked Nov 9, 2026.
h1: Cold email tools for HubSpot: lemlist, Instantly, Apollo, and Seamless.AI
dek: HubSpot is the CRM. The outbound tool is the layer that fills it, or wrecks it.
Four products, four jobs, for HubSpot teams picking a cold email or prospecting add-on.
disclosure: I earn a commission if you sign up through my link, at no extra cost to you. I only recommend tools I'd suggest anyway.

blocks.html: I'm not rewriting the Instantly deep-dives. Those live on Instantly and Instantly vs lemlist. This is the HubSpot-first roundup that links out.
Choose by what HubSpot needs to receive, not by mailbox volume alone.

items: Need sends and replies logged into HubSpot with field-level sync: start with lemlist.
Need cheap high-volume sending across many inboxes: Instantly (read the HubSpot limits on the Instantly page).
Need a prospecting database plus sequences with push and write rules: Apollo.io.
Need verified emails and dials imported into HubSpot: Seamless.AI.

blocks.html: Sending under about 50 personal emails a week on Sales Hub? HubSpot sequences may be enough. No affiliate link for that; there's nothing to sell you.
Volume without write rules fills HubSpot with junk.
Outbound or prospecting teams that keep HubSpot as the system of record. Not for teams replacing HubSpot with a sequencer CRM.
Not for: founders who already live in HubSpot sequences and don't need more mailboxes or a lead database.

sections.label: The HubSpot question to answer first

blocks.html: Before you compare brands, answer one question: what does HubSpot need to receive?

items: Activity logging (sends, replies, calls on the timeline)
List import only
Two-way field sync with overwrite rules
Enrichment or new contacts from a database

blocks.html: If you can't answer that, you'll buy volume and inherit cleanup.

sections.label: lemlist: deepest HubSpot outbound sync in this set

blocks.html: lemlist is multichannel outbound: email on the Email plan, with LinkedIn, calls, and more on Multichannel. The HubSpot angle is the sync.
Per lemlist's HubSpot page:

items: Import from HubSpot lists or views, with dedupe.
Map fields and choose sync behavior on create vs later updates.
Log outreach activity to the contact timeline; pick which activity types sync.
Auto-exit campaigns when lifecycle stage changes, a deal is created, or the contact leaves the list filter.
Launch from HubSpot via the lemlist icon.

blocks.html: lemlist's FAQ on that page: the integration works with all HubSpot paid plans and needs HubSpot admin access.

Prices from lemlist.com/pricing: Email $69 per month, or $55 per month billed yearly; Multichannel $109 per month, or $87 per month billed yearly; Enterprise custom. Billing options: Monthly, Quarterly (save 10%), or Yearly (save 20%). The FAQ lists a 14-day free trial with Multichannel features and 200 credits.
Head-to-head with Instantly (HubSpot logging vs price): Instantly vs lemlist.

sections.label: Instantly: volume sending (link out, don't duplicate)

blocks.html: Instantly is cold email infrastructure: unlimited email accounts with warmup, lead uploads, and campaigns. The entry Outbound plan is Growth at $47 per month (plans overview). Hyper Growth is $107 per month; Light Speed is $358 per month. Credits plans and Bundles sit beside Outbound, so read instantly.ai/pricing slowly before you pick.

HubSpot: Instantly's HubSpot marketplace page covers importing contacts and lists, and Automations from HubSpot events. Outcomes can sync back “using native automation connectors or enhanced with custom webhook and sync solutions.”

Plan gating: Instantly's Automations help article states the Automation Builder is available to all Outbound plans. HubSpot triggers and HubSpot actions live in that Automations builder. Outbound starts at Growth.
Full setup detail, OutboundSync notes, and when HubSpot sequences are enough: Instantly for HubSpot teams.

sections.label: Apollo.io: database plus sequences with sync rules

blocks.html: Apollo.io finds contacts, enriches them, and runs sequences. HubSpot keeps the lifecycle. Apollo's own framing: prospect in Apollo, grow in HubSpot.
Per apollo.io/apollo-hubspot:

items: Bi-directional sync of contacts, accounts, deals, and activity.
Push conditions (deal stage, email status, custom fields).
Write rules: overwrite vs fill empty.
Duplicate flags and a sync error log.
6-hour configuration window on paid plans before sync runs.
“Requires an Apollo subscription.”

blocks.html: More detail: Apollo.io.
Prices from the plan data on apollo.io/pricing:

items: Free Plan: $0
Basic Plan: $49 per month (billed monthly); the plan description includes CRM integrations
Professional Plan: $99 per month (billed monthly)
Enterprise: contact for pricing

blocks.html: Apollo's FAQ says annual billing is discounted vs monthly.
Set push rules before anyone imports a list. Loose rules are how portals get bloated for a quarter.
Seamless.AI is a contact data tool. The HubSpot question isn't “is the data good.” It's “what happens when reps click import.”
Per seamless.ai/products/integrations/hubspot: import contacts and companies, set match scores, customize mappings, enrich records.
Seamless also positions itself as a data source for HubSpot's Breeze Prospecting Agent.

Prices: Free plan with 50 credits on the free plan (vendor pricing article). Paid plans are custom; Seamless does not publish a public paid dollar price on the pages I checked. Credit allowances on their education article: Basic 250 Universal Credits per month; Pro 10,000 Universal Credits per month. Those are credits, not dollars.
Decide match scores and who can auto-import before you connect it. Details: Seamless.AI.

items: HubSpot sequences already cover your volume: stay put.
Need native HubSpot email and activity logging from outbound: lemlist.
Need the cheapest high-volume send: Instantly, and read the activity-sync limits.
Need data and outbound in one product with sync controls: Apollo.
Need phones and emails into HubSpot only: Seamless.
Before any connect: clean duplicates and lifecycle.

faq.q: What cold email tool works best with HubSpot?
faq.a: It depends what “works” means. lemlist has the deepest native HubSpot outbound sync in this group. Instantly focuses on sending volume. Apollo adds a large contact database with sync controls. Seamless.AI is mainly for contact data.

faq.q: How much do these tools cost?
faq.a: Instantly Outbound starts at $47 per month (Growth). lemlist Email is $69 per month, or $55 per month billed yearly. Apollo's pricing page lists Basic at $49 per month and Professional at $99 per month. Seamless paid pricing is custom; free includes 50 credits on the free plan. Re-check vendor pages the day you buy.

faq.q: Will these tools duplicate my HubSpot contacts?
faq.a: They can, if import or push rules are loose. Set match keys, decide overwrite vs fill-empty, and limit who can auto-import before you connect anything.
faq.aHtml: They can, if import or push rules are loose. Set match keys, decide overwrite vs fill-empty, and limit who can auto-import before you connect anything.

faq.a: Usually no, if volume is low and everything already lives in HubSpot. Add an outbound tool when you need more mailboxes, multichannel steps, or a prospecting database HubSpot doesn't replace.

closing: The tool isn't the risk. The import rules are.
